import os
import subprocess
import sys

import pandas as pd

# Mandatory skill initialization before spreadsheet operations
init_script = os.path.join(
    os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)),
    ".codex", "skills", "xlsx", "resources", "file_check.sh",
)
subprocess.run(["bash", init_script], check=True)

path = "budget.xlsx"
if not os.path.exists(path):
    sys.exit(f"File not found: {path}")

sheets = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=None)
print("Sheets:", list(sheets.keys()))

for name, df in sheets.items():
    print(f"\n=== Sheet: {name} ===")
    print("Shape:", df.shape)
    print("Columns:", list(df.columns))
    print(df.to_string())

    num_cols = df.select_dtypes(include="number").columns.tolist()
    if not num_cols:
        print("No numeric columns found.")
        continue

    # Find a category-like column (text column) if present
    cat_col = None
    for col in df.columns:
        if col not in num_cols and df[col].map(lambda v: isinstance(v, str)).mean() > 0.8:
            cat_col = col
            break

    if cat_col and len(num_cols) == 1:
        col = num_cols[0]
        grouped = df.groupby(cat_col, dropna=False)[col].sum()
        print(f"\nTotals by {cat_col!r} (column {col!r}):")
        print(grouped.to_string())
        print(f"\nGRAND TOTAL ({col}): {grouped.sum()}")
    else:
        for col in num_cols:
            print(f"TOTAL ({col}): {df[col].sum()}")
